Despite multiple attempts, WebSurfer remained stuck in a loop without progressing toward obtaining precise pricing information. The lack of meaningful advancement in retrieving usable data from DHL caused the task to stall early and contributed to the final incorrect response. Instead of refocusing on alternative services (USPS, FedEx) or employing a more effective strategy for extracting DHL rates, WebSurfer wasted time repeating the same unproductive actions.
